svg.title: ArduCade Pro Micro electrical schematic
svg.desc: USB powered 5 V 16 MHz Pro Micro, seven-pin SSD1306 SPI module, six active-low buttons, passive piezo between D5 and D9, and a two-pin reset button. Matching net names connect electrically. Unverified battery components are excluded from the powered circuit.

g.text: ArduCade · 5 V / 16 MHz · USB power · matching net names connect electrically
USB connector and regulator are part of the board.
RAW is unused in this USB-powered circuit.
128 × 64 · 7 pins · must accept 5 V power and signals
Follow the printed pin names, not the header position.
A 6-pin module needs verified SPI mode and CS wiring.
OLED RES connects to D6; it is separate from board RST.
Normally open · active LOW · internal pull-ups · no external resistors
Passive piezo · two-pin momentary reset button
D5 outputs sound. D9 is held LOW by ArduCade.
Battery parts: connection not yet verified
Two 3 V coin cells, a three-pin switch and the reference 10 kΩ resistor are not connected here.
About 6 V in series must never connect directly to VCC. Verify the board regulator before using RAW.
No battery charger, RGB LEDs or original Arduboy PCB circuitry is required for the USB build shown above.
Pin assignments are generated from the ArduCade Pro Micro profile. Module symbols are not physical pin layouts.
